name: ttyd-rs
description: Share your terminal over the web

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:rust
scripts.build:release: pnpm run build:web && cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.check: pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:rust
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: pnpm run format:web && pnpm run format:rust
